description: AST research for PROV-091 - Image multimodal content in core types and Rhai request bridge

ContentPart_match_sites.context: extract_text_from_content - uses `if let ContentPart::Text {..}` filter_map - non-text variants already return None; new Image variant needs no change
convert_assistant_content builds ContentPart::Text/ToolUse from rig::AssistantContent. Assistant-side Image still rejected (line 154-159)
part_from_map - matches part_type string 'text' | 'tool_use' | other (error). Unknown types error out; image in response parse intentionally rejected

request_bridge_pipeline.note: Uses serde_json::to_value(&messages) then json_value_to_dynamic. Any new ContentPart variant with Serialize impl round-trips transparently through the bridge.

findings.adapter_exhaustive_matches: extract_text_from_content uses `if let` not `match` so new variants compile without changes; convert_assistant_content matches on rig::AssistantContent not ContentPart - unaffected by our new variant.

builtin_providers_impact.claude.rs: Uses extract_text_from_content / adapter helpers - no direct ContentPart::Image handling needed for text-prompt flow
builtin_providers_impact.openai.rs: Same - consumes text prompts via helpers

findings.response_bridge_negative_test: part_from_map with 'image' type must return Err because images are request-only; this is the other edge of the bridge being unidirectional.

scope_decisions: Add ContentPart::Image { source: ImageSource } with ImageSource::Url { url } and ImageSource::Base64 { media_type, data }
Re-export ImageSource via codelet_common::lib and codelet_common::types module
Explicitly add Image no-text arm to extract_text_from_content (even though if-let would suffice) to document intent and future-proof against match-refactor
Do NOT extend convert_assistant_content - assistant images remain rejected
Do NOT extend response_bridge::part_from_map - response parsing of images remains rejected
All tests live in common (serde), providers/tests/ (bridge + adapter)
